title: Narra 4.1.30 — integrity gate fix
message: Gate settings now apply correctly. If 4.1.28 is installed, sync your account, uninstall it once, then install 4.1.30 from the official release page. Narra 4.1.29 updates normally.
changelog: The App Integrity gate now follows live admin settings without a stale local certificate blocker.
Every cold launch requires fresh gateway approval; cached offline approval can no longer bypass the gate.
One-time signing migration: sync, uninstall 4.1.28, then install this release; later updates work in place.
The anime player now offers Fit, Fill, and Stretch modes with cleaner gesture controls.
Buffering no longer switches servers automatically; choose and retry servers manually.
Megaplay and AniHQ extraction are updated, with failed streams filtered before playback.
Free playback now consistently completes its ad or timed fallback gate.
A compact CubeTV showcase appears after Anime Continue Watching and stays remotely configurable.
